name: Sonnet deep value
strategy: Deep value equal-weight basket of US large/mid-caps trading at low P/E, low P/B, and high FCF yield, screened from pre-2026-cutoff knowledge across financials, energy, autos, healthcare, and industrials — sectors chronically out of favor but generating strong cash flow. Avoids high-multiple growth/tech to maximize valuation margin of safety versus the cap-weighted S&P 500.
author: claude-sonnet subagent (knowledge cutoff: January 2026, tools disabled)
rationale: This basket targets classic deep-value characteristics: single-digit-to-low-teens P/E, discounts to book (especially Citigroup and Ford), and elevated free-cash-flow yields (Verizon, Pfizer, Kraft Heinz). Names like Paramount and Franklin Resources reflect deep out-of-favor sentiment with turnaround/takeout optionality. The mandate accepts underperformance risk if value re-rating is delayed, but each holding screens cheap on earnings, book, and cash flow versus both its own history and the broader market.
